responsibility: Declares the TyTy-level call checkers used after expression or method resolution has identified a callable type. TypeCheckCallExpr handles plain call expressions over constructors, fn defs, and fn pointers; Argument packages already-resolved argument metadata; and TypeCheckMethodCallExpr validates method-call argument lists against a resolved FnType and adjusted self receiver.
same_name_distinction: Declares the call-checker interfaces and Argument data carrier for this stem, while the paired .cc file performs the real per-call validation, receiver unification, coercion, and return-type computation.
